story.label: Our story
story.title: Student housing with a human face
story.p1: Mijn-Kot rents quality student rooms and studios in Leuven. We manage four buildings in top locations - in the bustling city center and quiet Heverlee.
story.p2: What sets us apart? We are not a mediation agency. You rent directly from the owner - fast, fair and without hidden costs. All our rooms are furnished, fire-safety certified and carry the official
story.p3: We work closely with the KU Leuven Housing Service and provide professional maintenance through our own handyman. If there is a problem, we solve it.
